evidence.note: Driver-side door is closed immediately before manipulation.
User grips the driver-side door handle; opening transition begins.
Driver-side door remains open before closing.
User pushes the driver-side door inward during the closing transition.

events.object_description: Driver-side door of the blue Toyota Supra

evidence.note: Front hood is closed as the user reaches toward its leading edge.
Hood has been partially lifted; opening transition is underway.
Hood is fully raised, exposing the engine bay.
User grasps the raised hood to begin lowering it.
Hood is nearly closed under the user's hand.

events.object_description: Front engine hood of the blue Toyota Supra

evidence.note: Rear hatch is closed as the user reaches underneath the spoiler/hatch edge.
User lifts the rear hatch; opening transition is underway.
Rear hatch is raised and the cargo compartment is exposed.
Rear hatch remains fully open immediately before closing.
User pulls the rear hatch downward during the closing transition.

events.object_description: Rear cargo hatch of the blue Toyota Supra

notes: Three distinct localized manipulation episodes are visible: the driver-side door, front hood, and rear cargo hatch. The initial and intervening camera circling sequences are surveys and were not counted.
scene_description: A user circles a parked blue Toyota Supra in an outdoor parking lot and sequentially opens and closes the driver-side door, front hood, and rear cargo hatch.
